The Money Move Promise

  • One agent, your choice. Your info goes to exactly one agent — the one you pick.
  • Never sold. Never shared. We don't sell leads. Not to agents, lenders, or anyone.
  • Swap any time. Text "swap" and meet the next agent on your list. No cost, no awkwardness.
  • Fees up front. You see each agent's typical buyer fee and agreement terms before you meet.
  • Free. Always. Agents pay us from their commission only when you close.
  • No lender steering. We never take money from lenders, title or insurance companies. Use whoever you want.
Read the full promise
Is it really free?

Yes. You never pay us. When you close, your agent's brokerage pays us a referral fee out of their commission. That's it — no markup, no "platform fee," nothing added to your side of the deal.

Why does your agent beat the one I'd find myself?

Because we pick on results, not marketing. We compare agents on closed sales in your exact area and price range, how close their sellers get to asking price, days on market, how often deals fall apart, and what verified past clients say. You see all of it before you talk to anyone.

Will I get 10 phone calls?

No. You pick one agent from your shortlist, and only that agent gets your number. We never sell or share your info. Ever.

What if I don't click with my agent?

Text your Move Manager "swap" and we'll introduce the next agent on your list. No awkward conversation, no cost.

What changed with buyer commissions?

Buyer-agent fees are negotiable, and in Texas (since Jan 1, 2026) your agent needs a written agreement with you before working for you. You can start with a short, non-exclusive showing agreement (14 days or less). We show each agent's typical fee and agreement terms before you meet, in plain English.

How do you make money?

When you close, your agent's brokerage pays us a 25% referral fee from their commission. Every partner pays the same rate, so no one can buy a better ranking. It never changes your price.

Do you work outside Texas?

Yes — we refer through licensed partner brokerages nationwide. Moving to or from DFW is our specialty.
